snippet.title: CRATERBORN – Open Beta Trailer | Free Browser Extraction Game
snippet.description:
CRATERBORN is a free-to-play PvPvE extraction game you play right in your browser – on PC or phone, no install. The open beta is live.
▶ Play free: https://craterborn.com

The keepers say a star fell here. It tore the earth open to the heart.

Beneath the lantern town, the ground split open. Four rings lead down into the crater – the deeper you go, the richer the loot and the deadlier the things that guard it. A run lasts ten minutes, and there is one rule: loot only counts once you carry it out. Die, and your pack stays behind for someone else.

⚔ Play as the Warden, who smashes enemies with a hammer, or the Skirmisher, who strikes from range
🔥 Fight elites that hit with magma, frost and turf, and bring down the Mossy Golem
🕷 Drop down the shaft into the meteor chamber, where the Hunter – a giant spider – guards unique sets. There is no way out down there: you carry the loot back up through all four rings
🗡 Other players hunt the same chests – and you. Team up, grab the keepers' supply drop, or ambush someone at the exit
🏮 Back in town, upgrade your gear, weave missing set pieces and get ready for the next descent

No pay-to-win – money only buys looks.

Go deep. Carry it out.

Play free:
🌐 https://craterborn.com

Original music composed for this trailer.

#CRATERBORN #ExtractionGame #BrowserGame
